brands.evidence: I’d pick Monzo if you want one account that makes budgeting easier or you regularly pay by card abroad.
I’d pick Nationwide FlexDirect as your main account if your salary and bills naturally qualify for its rewards.

client_claims.note: Facts show paid plans exist, but the free plan has no monthly fee; the claim is about the free account, which the facts do not state.

client_claims.text: Monzo passes on Mastercard’s exchange rate without adding a fee on card purchases.
Monzo's Salary Sorter can set aside bills and savings into separate Pots on payday.
On the free account, each deposit at a Post Office or PayPoint costs £1.
client_claims.note: Cash deposit fees are not covered by the facts.
